entities.summary: Den Harrow was an Italo disco music project that had numerous chart hits in Continental Europe during the second half of the 1980s. Den Harrow was portrayed by male model Stefano Zandri, who served as the face of the project, while American singer Tom Hooker did most of the vocals.
